input: Find STEM, science, coding, academic, cooking and enrichment summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Black Mountain, Swannanoa, Montreat and Old Fort, NC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Black Mountain Swannanoa summer camp 2026 science STEM cooking
